_comment: Logo decoration workflow — takes an existing SVG or PNG logo and wraps it with a FLUX-generated decorative layer.
_description: Logo decorator: isolate mark → generate decoration → composite. Change decoration_prompt in node 5 and src in node 1.
_runner: See bin/run_workflow.sh for the bash implementation.

1._comment: Render SVG logo to raster PNG. Skip this node if your input is already a PNG — wire node 2 src directly to your PNG path.

2._comment: RMBG: isolate the logo mark, strip background → RGBA PNG. The isolated mark stays crisp over any FLUX-generated background.

3._comment: BLIP: describe the logo mark — feeds into the decoration prompt so FLUX knows what it's decorating around.

5._comment: Compose the FLUX decoration prompt. Change decoration_prompt to control the style — this is the main creative input.

inputs.template: {caption}, {decoration_prompt}, professional graphic design, centered composition, no text, studio quality
caption: caption
inputs.decoration_prompt: wrapped in Art Nouveau botanical gold vines on dark midnight blue background

4._comment: FLUX.1-schnell: generate the decorative background layer using the composed prompt.

6._comment: Layer the isolated logo mark (fg_path) centered over the FLUX decoration background. scale controls how large the mark is relative to the canvas.

7._comment: Collect all artifacts into one playlist for review in TT-TV.
